siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of L'Enclume
siblings.summary: Eleven characterful places to sleep near L'Enclume — from the restaurant's own rooms in a 13th-century smithy to a Rogan-run country house above Windermere, ranked by taxi minutes back to Cartmel.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of L'Enclume
siblings.summary: What to do around Cartmel within a 30 km radius — village walks, Lake Windermere and Coniston, Ruskin and Beatrix Potter, country houses, fells, and Morecambe Bay — graded by half-day, full-day and after-dinner picks.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of L'Enclume

sources.title: L'Enclume — Stay
sources.claim: L'Enclume's bedrooms and suites are dotted around Cartmel within walking distance of the restaurant; all room reservations include breakfast at Rogan & Co and a guaranteed table at L'Enclume.

sources.title: L'Enclume — Our Rooms
sources.claim: L'Enclume has 16 individually designed bedrooms in four categories across Cartmel village.

sources.title: Visit Lake District — Our Rooms by L'Enclume
sources.claim: L'Enclume's 16 bedrooms are dispersed in different areas of Cartmel, all a short walk to the restaurants.

sources.title: Stray Sleep Eat — L'Enclume, Cartmel
sources.claim: L'Enclume rooms are dotted in different buildings within Cartmel, all walking distance to the restaurant; the DB&B package (Tue-Fri) bundles bed, sparkling wine on arrival, the 15-course tasting menu and breakfast at Rogan & Co.

sources.title: Finest — Stay at L'Enclume
sources.claim: L'Enclume rooms come in four categories: Suites, Junior Suites, Superior Rooms and Double Rooms; all include Nespresso machines and Bose sound systems.

sources.title: The Hotel Guru — L'Enclume
sources.claim: L'Enclume bedrooms are clustered in cottages or in a townhouse overlooking the village square, with rates starting around $174 per night.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotels near L'Enclume
sources.claim: Hotels closest to L'Enclume by distance: Cavendish Arms (0.0 mi), Cartmel Old Grammar (0.3 mi), Aynsome Manor (0.7 mi), Uplands Inn (0.9 mi).

sources.title: Cool Places — The Cavendish Arms
sources.claim: The Cavendish Arms sits on Cavendish Street with 10 rooms at £75-£125 including breakfast in a 450-year-old coaching inn.

sources.title: Stay in a Pub — The Cavendish Arms
sources.claim: The Cavendish Arms is a 500-year-old Grade II listed coaching inn next to Cartmel Priory's archways, a stone's throw from L'Enclume.

sources.title: The Kings Arms
sources.claim: The Kings Arms sits on Cartmel Square with six rooms named after Romantic poets in an 18th-century building.

sources.title: The Lake District — The Royal Oak Inn
sources.claim: The Royal Oak Inn sits in The Square at the heart of Cartmel village, just around the corner from L'Enclume, with rooms above the pub and full cooked breakfast included.

sources.title: Cartmel Old Grammar
sources.claim: Cartmel Old Grammar is a Georgian boutique country house surrounded by the Cartmel Racecourse, with sophisticated rooms and on-site dining at the Refectory Restaurant.

sources.title: Expedia — Cartmel Old Grammar
sources.claim: Cartmel Old Grammar features 12 individually designed bedrooms with free cooked-to-order breakfast and two lounge/bar areas with log fires.

sources.title: Aynsome Manor
sources.claim: Aynsome Manor is a five-star Georgian B&B with a locally-sourced Cartmel breakfast, evening turndown, and complimentary chauffeur service for the local area.

sources.title: Aynsome Manor — Hotels Lake District
sources.claim: Aynsome Manor sits ¾ mile from Cartmel village, a 15-minute walk through open meadowland.

sources.title: Uplands Inn
sources.claim: Uplands Inn is an independent family-run inn with eight bedrooms set in two acres of gardens between Cartmel and Grange-over-Sands.

sources.title: Booking.com — Uplands Inn
sources.claim: Uplands Inn is roughly a 15-minute walk from Cartmel village, though some reviews put the walk at 20-30 minutes.

sources.title: Visit Lake District — L'Enclume
sources.claim: L'Enclume's address is Cavendish Street, Cartmel, Cumbria LA11 6QA.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Heft
sources.claim: Heft is a Michelin-starred inn with rooms in Newton-in-Cartmel, outside walking distance from Cartmel village.

sources.title: Kents Bank Holiday — Heft Inn
sources.claim: Heft is a 17th-century inn in High Newton run by Kevin Tickle (a former L'Enclume sous chef of eight years) with five guest rooms.
